name: The dragon who tests the mask

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

summary: In the heat and dark water of Dustwallow Marsh, Emberstrife tests the forged appearance and sends the adventurers to claim dragon skulls from distant guardians. Three trials await beneath different skies, where the black dragonflight and its rivals still shape the wilds. Emberstrife will accept each skull as part of his demand; Myranda’s borrowed shape must hold until the passage is won.
